subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should bad Telegram/session-store JSON recovery be diagnostic-only, explicit backup-first reset, or automatic quarantine on load?
rationale: All three options can address the outage, but they make different tradeoffs around persisted session continuity, operator control, and overlap with the generic session-store recovery work.

options.title: Diagnostic plus explicit reset
options.body: Status or doctor reports file health and points to a backup-first reset command, keeping destructive action operator-controlled.

options.title: Diagnostic only
options.body: Status or doctor reports corrupt or oversized state and safe manual steps, leaving reset automation for later work.

options.title: Automatic quarantine
options.body: Gateway load moves bad state aside and recreates clean state, maximizing recovery while taking the largest compatibility and data-continuity risk.

recommendation.title: Diagnostic plus explicit reset
recommendation.body: Status or doctor reports file health and points to a backup-first reset command, keeping destructive action operator-controlled.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Telegram status UX and channel/plugin reliability, where steipete has the strongest recent history signal.
